story.iWant: initialize and configure one or more companies with isolated data and branding
story.soThat: the system cleanly supports multiple tenants from the start
story.tasks: - Backend: Company entity, repository, service, controller (AC: #1, #2, #3) - Flyway migrations for companies table (unique code, unique tax_code, VN charset where applicable) - Service methods: createCompany, updateCompany, getCompanyByCode, listCompanies (scoped by auth) - Validation: 10-digit tax code; duplicate code/tax_code rejection with detailed error - Backend: Multitenancy enforcement (AC: #3) - Security filter to inject company_id scope on all requests - Repository layer guards and integration tests to ensure scoping - Backend: Demo company bootstrap (AC: #4) - CLI/script to seed demo company and minimal reference data - Idempotency: safe re-run without duplicates - Frontend: Company creation form and validations (AC: #1, #2) - Fields: code, name, tax_code, address, logo upload; VN charset validation - Error display for duplicate code/tax_code and invalid fields - Frontend: Company switcher in authenticated shell (AC: #5, #6) - Persist selected company in session; ensure API calls include company scope - Display branding (logo/name) in header and report exports - Testing - Backend: Unit + integration tests for validation, scoping, and seed idempotency - Frontend: Form validation tests and company switch UX test

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. First login (or CLI/script) prompts to create the first company; reject duplicate company codes. 2. Company form validates: unique 10-digit tax code, company name (VN charset), address, logo. 3. All core data (users, chart of accounts, vouchers, master data) associated with a company_id and enforced at the DB and API layer. 4. Demo company auto-created with realistic data for preview/demo 5. Switching company context (if user belongs to multiple) works without session corruption. 6. Company branding (logo, name) appears in dashboard shell and voucher/report exports.
Validation specifics: a. Code format: ^[A-Z0-9-]{3,16}$; server returns 409 on duplicate code or tax_code with { field, reason } details. b. Tax code: exactly 10 digits; VN charset allowed for company name and address. c. Branding: logo PNG/JPEG ≤ 256KB; stored path referenced in UI header and export footer. d. Scope enforcement: all CRUD endpoints require and persist company_id; cross-company access returns 403 with message code RBAC_COMPANY_SCOPE_VIOLATION. e. Context switch: changing active company updates auth/session context and invalidates cached queries; no leakage across company boundaries (verified by tests).

story-context.constraints: Enforce row-level scoping with company_id at API and repository layers; duplicate code/tax_code must return structured errors; branding paths referenced in UI and exports; JWT-based security with tenant scoping filter.
story-context.interfaces: REST base /api/v1/companies; endpoints: POST create, PUT update, GET list/detail; demo bootstrap endpoint per Dev Notes.

tests.standards: Backend: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test + Testcontainers (Postgres). Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library. Structured error responses and RBAC checks per PRD.
tests.ideas: AC1: first-company prompt/CLI + duplicate company code rejection. AC2: FE form validation + backend 10-digit tax code check. AC3: repository-level filters enforce company_id across CRUD. AC4: demo seed idempotency test. AC5: session context switch invalidates caches; no leakage across companies. AC6: branding appears in header and export footer.
